title: Holo Scanner
body: The scanner captures an area of blocks into a Projection Crystal. Right-click it to set where the area is (up to 32 blocks away) and how big (up to 32 each way), and give the projection a name.
Each scan costs one amethyst shard and gives you a crystal. Put it in a [[holo_projector|Holo Projector]] to see it.
